name: Hollow Hill House
tagline: A Halloween party at the spookiest house in the village: costumes, pumpkins, and a mystery for the whole family.
description: Every Halloween, kindly old Mr. Bramble opens creaky Hollow Hill House for the village costume party: a pumpkin contest, a witch's-brew punch bowl, and a trophy called the Golden Pumpkin. This year, somebody spoiled the fun. Spooky, never scary: a family-friendly mystery for all ages.
artStyle: Storybook Halloween illustration, a crooked old mansion on a hill, glowing jack-o'-lanterns, friendly bats, purple night sky

cocktails.name: Witch's Brew Punch
cocktails.recipe: Green apple juice, lemonade and lime sherbet, with gummy worms hanging over the rim.
cocktails.mocktail: It's already alcohol-free. Add dry ice (carefully, with a grown-up) for spooky mist.
